title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
statement: Return the level order traversal, but alternate direction: the first level left to right, the second right to left, the third left to right, and so on.
reference_solution:
def zigzagLevelOrder(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    ltr = True
    while level:
        vals = [n.val for n in level]
        out.append(vals if ltr else vals[::-1])
        ltr = not ltr
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

hints.1_question: It is still a level-order traversal. What changes from level to level?
hints.2_nudge: Collect each level normally, then reverse the values of every other level. Never change the order in which you visit the children.
hints.3_big_hint: Keep a boolean ltr. After building vals for a level, append vals or vals[::-1]; flip the flag.

known_bugs.name: reverses the queue itself on odd levels
known_bugs.code:
def zigzagLevelOrder(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    ltr = True
    while level:
        out.append([n.val for n in level] if ltr else [n.val for n in level][::-1])
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
        if ltr:
            level = level[::-1]
        ltr = not ltr
    return out
